name: METFORMIN / VILDAGLIPTINE 850MG/50MG 30 TABLETS
description: The combination of Metformin/Vildagliptin (1000 mg/50 mg) is an oral antidiabetic medication indicated for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus in adults who do not achieve adequate control with maximum doses of metformin alone or who are already using both drugs separately. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
